audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer text repeatedly names Hwei's E as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability called Subject: Fear anywhere in his kit.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/hwei.json lists E as 'Subject: Torment' (cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10) — the CC-painting slot (Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw). 'Subject: Fear' is a fabricated name, the same class of error as Brand's 'Ares of Blaze' and Cassiopeia's 'Noxious Blight' called out in calibration.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (CC Paints)' in winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, loading, focus.text, dosFull[0], and the Key Ability Interactions report entry.

audit.why: Tricky matchup for Lulu (7/10 diff, winRate 49.0%) — Hwei's range/burst wins levels 1-2 and 4-6, Lulu claws back only at level 3 and outscales at 2 items, matching the packet levelChart (Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Lulu).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns called Subject: Torment matchup-defining but gave no cooldown number, and the full-layer level chart (Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill) contradicted content win[] (Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Lulu), which the packet confirms is the real result.
audit.why: Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — a real number for the 'dodge the paint' advice. The chart disagreement means the page's level-chart widget and its level-by-level prose would tell the reader two different stories for levels 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Realigned phases[3,4,5,6].side to content win[] and rewrote the matching .why lines; folded the real cooldown into breakdown.cooldowns.
